create_kbinsdiscretizer_uniform: create a KBinsDiscretizer with uniform strategy to discretize continuous features into equal-width bins
create_kbinsdiscretizer_quantile: create a KBinsDiscretizer with quantile strategy to discretize features so each bin has approximately the same number of samples
create_kbinsdiscretizer_kmeans: create a KBinsDiscretizer with kmeans strategy to discretize features based on KMeans clustering centroids
test_kbinsdiscretizer_fit_transform: test KBinsDiscretizer fit and transform methods with ordinal encoding on a 2D dataset
test_make_blobs_dataset: test make_blobs to generate clustered sample data with specified centers and cluster standard deviations
